packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the native (Go) compiler and typescript-eslint cannot load it yet, so lint crashes. Stay on 6.x until typescript-eslint supports 7, then remove this rule.

Every update merges itself once the CI verify check (lint and build without warnings, tests) is green, majors included. Renovate merges the PR itself instead of GitHub auto-merge: main has no branch protection (the blog and events sync workflows push to it directly), so GitHub auto-merge would not wait for CI.
